title: Layout
description: full = background band, difficulty line, stat row and object counts. compact = a slim strip: title, difficulty, mods and an inline stat row.

title: Original-language titles
description: Show the title and artist in their original script (titleUnicode / artistUnicode) when the map has them.

title: Background art
description: Show the map's background as a dimmed band behind the title.

title: Stat rows
description: Show the difficulty settings, BPM and length row (plus object counts in the full layout). Mod-adjusted values show the original first: 9→10.33.

title: Anchor
description: Which edge of the source the card sticks to when its height changes (compact layout, stats hidden, two-line titles).

title: 18—LAB tag
description: Show the 18—LAB tag in the card header.
